author: Axiom I
title: Invert Veritas v2.7 corr via rebase01 (additive)
abstract: If storage/veritas/v2_7_scores.csv exists, invert 'corr' with rebase01 → shared/agency_lab/analyses/csv/veritas_v2_7_scores_inverted.csv. Stdlib + shared adapter.

original_submission.content:
import os, sys

IN = os.path.join("storage","veritas","v2_7_scores.csv")
OUT = os.path.join("storage","shared","agency_lab","analyses","csv","veritas_v2_7_scores_inverted.csv")

def main():
    if not os.path.exists(IN):
        print("WARN input missing:", IN)
        return 0
    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(OUT), exist_ok=True)
    sys.path.append("storage/shared")
    from agency_lab.utilities.inverted_metrics_adapter_v0_1 import invert_file
    invert_file(IN, OUT, columns=["corr"], method="rebase01", suffix="_inv")
    return 0

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
